theme.title: Full-Court Mix
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did LeBron's 2008–09 Cavaliers win?
questions.note: 66 victories, the best record in the NBA that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They finished the regular season with 66 wins and 16 losses

funFacts.text: LeBron won his first MVP award and finished runner-up in Defensive Player of the Year voting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James won his first MVP Award and finished second in Defensive Player of the Year voting.

funFacts.text: Mike Brown earned Coach of the Year honors as Cleveland raced to the East's top seed.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Brown was named NBA Coach of the Year for the 2008–2009 season.

funFacts.text: Cleveland ended its playoff run after sweeping both Detroit and Atlanta, before Orlando stopped them in the conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Cavaliers swept the Detroit Pistons in the First Round in four games, swept the Atlanta Hawks in the Semifinals in four games

questions.prompt: How many straight games did Larry Brown's Pistons win across December and January?
questions.note: Thirteen straight during Brown's first season in Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they went on a 13-game winning streak between December and January

funFacts.text: That midwinter streak was part of Larry Brown's first year running Detroit, after he replaced the previous coaching staff.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After their first trip to the Conference Finals since 1991, the Pistons hired Larry Brown as head coach.

funFacts.text: The championship season wasn't all smooth: Detroit also suffered a six-game losing streak in February.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they struggled in February, losing six straight games.

funFacts.text: Detroit finished second in its own Central Division yet still went on to win the league championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing second in the Central Division with a 54–28 record.

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Jrue Holiday average in the 2021 playoffs?
questions.note: 8.7 assists a game from Milwaukee's two-way guard.

funFacts.text: Holiday started all 23 of Milwaukee's playoff games.
His late steal against Devin Booker set up an alley-oop that swung Finals Game 5.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jrue Holiday stole the ball from Devin Booker and passed it to Giannis Antetokounmpo for an alley-oop

funFacts.text: Holiday had been acquired from New Orleans in Milwaukee's offseason reshuffle.

questions.prompt: How many points did Jack Sikma score in Game 7 against Phoenix in 1979?
questions.context: Seattle · Western Conference finals · deciding game
questions.note: 33 points from Sikma to put Seattle into the Finals.

funFacts.text: Fred Brown led the Sonics with five assists in the winner-take-all contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 17 Phoenix W 114–110 Jack Sikma (33) Jack Sikma (11) Fred Brown (5)

funFacts.text: Over thirty-seven thousand fans watched Seattle survive the deciding game.
The Sonics advanced to face the defending champion Washington Bullets again.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: facing the defending NBA champion Washington Bullets

questions.prompt: Elgin Baylor led the Lakers to the Finals how many times, losing every one?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: helped lead the team to the NBA Finals eight times, but the team lost each time.

funFacts.text: Baylor retired just before the Lakers embarked on their landmark winning streak and won the championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Baylor missed two historic achievements: the Lakers' first game afterwards began an NBA record 33-game win streak

funFacts.text: During an Army Reserve deployment, Baylor could join the Lakers only on weekend passes and flew coach to games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he could play for the Lakers only when on a weekend pass

funFacts.text: The Lakers were struggling financially when Baylor arrived; their owner credited him with keeping the franchise alive.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Baylor immediately exceeded expectations and ultimately saved the Lakers franchise
